shots.camera_intent: scan the square with the walk, keep the bell in frame
shots.caption_line: the winter the river stopped, the bell stopped with it
shots.lighting: moon key (cool, high), window pools (warm, low), no fill outside the pools
shots.note: establishing: two figures cross the square toward the bell, camera pans with them

shots.camera_intent: close the distance to the keeper: pressure, not movement
shots.caption_line: nine days, the keeper said, and nobody rings it but me
shots.lighting: practical lamp as key, cold night as rim, hard warm/cold split
shots.note: threshold shot: warm interior against cold snow, the keeper blocks the door

shots.camera_intent: hold on the face, let the realisation land
shots.caption_line: he had rung it once before. it did not end well.
shots.lighting: warm key from camera left, cold ambient, no hard shadows
shots.note: realisation: push-in on the keeper's face, no camera trick beyond the move

shots.camera_intent: follow the digging, reveal the grave
shots.caption_line: so the apprentice dug, and the ground rang instead
shots.lighting: contre-jour low sun, long soft shadows towards camera, cold bounce from snow
shots.note: the action beat: real digging motion, sun behind, long shadows

shots.camera_intent: reveal the bell from rim to crown
shots.caption_line: and the bell, at last, answered.
shots.lighting: single warm source from below-left, deep blue ambient
shots.note: insert: the object that resolves the story, dust in the light, no zoom-as-animation
